scope.note: The results label file for calendar year 2023 is loaded but only Jan-Feb matched odds/line records are evaluated; 2023-03+ prices and lines are not processed. Other research already used these later results in prior studies.

definitions.favorite: Lowest numeric final 3連単 exact ticket price in full book
definitions.published_line: Published predicted formation, not observed in-race actual partnership
definitions.market_pair: Two different published lines with highest aggregate market 1st-place probability from full 3連単
definitions.longest_pair: Two longest published lines; tie broken by car numbers, NOT finish or price
definitions.union: Full Cartesian slot product for each listed formation component; duplicate ordered tickets bought once
definitions.cost: 100 yen per distinct ticket in full set every eligible race, regardless outcome
definitions.returns: 100 * archived FINAL odds of exact finish if and only if exact finish is inside full set
definitions.candidate_policy: All predefined real-line formations; no post-result refinement, no ranking method fitting
definitions.no_selection: No 'buy if this condition' deployed; descriptive comparisons only
definitions.market_expected_set_hit: Sum of normalized inverse three-way odds across all exact tickets in the set

warnings: These are observational total-set portfolio returns, NOT estimates of prospective edge.
The 'best' row in each odds bin is best after seeing historical outcomes, and cannot be treated as an executable strategy without time-out testing.
Market conditional ranking may regress to market average; other longest-line selection offers market-independent control.
Uses FINAL odds and does not prove T-15 bet availability.
Only races in overlapping documented public line data and verified complete quote/result archives; not full-universe random sample.
Published line formation does not prove actual tactical lines raced.
All form policies overlap, therefore results are correlated; do not aggregate profits across families as if independent.
Scans 34 policies and 7 favorite odds bands, with many comparisons. No multiple-testing correction.
No complete generic formation optimization; this is descriptive observation of documented LINE STRUCTURAL FAMILIES.
